channel.title: Paracausal Telemetry
channel.description: CTF writeups, threat-actor dossiers, and defensive security notes.

item.title: Writeup: Mement0
item.description: An offline AI/ML challenge where a scraping agent's CLAUDE.md standing memory and .claude skills are turned against it to recover a rite deleted from the record but kept in the repo's older history.

item.title: Writeup: Saltlock Drift
item.description: A RollJam-style RF replay on a GateCar RF-433 fob: jam the receiver, sniff two presses, then replay an unused rolling code to unlock and reveal the token.

item.title: Writeup: What the Shard Displayed
item.description: Reconstruct a sigrok/PulseView logic-analyzer capture of an embedded display device to recover the image it painted, and the token drawn with it.

item.title: Writeup: Ash-Vault Interlock
item.description: Drive a Modbus/TCP interlock PLC and its HMI to halt an unstable cycle, force the seal-ready state, and release the checkpoint token from the alarm table.

item.title: Writeup: Crownspire Transfer
item.description: Use an IEC 60870-5-104 RTU and a captured maintenance session to force an interlocked power transfer and collect the feeder-trip checkpoint token.

item.title: Writeup: Line Tap
item.description: A forgotten RiverGate PLC still answers over telnet; sign in on old maintenance habits and read back the latest checkpoint token.

item.title: Writeup: h4cked
item.description: TryHackMe room using a packet capture to reconstruct an FTP compromise, identify the attacker's web shell path, then replay the intrusion to recover the root flag.

item.title: Writeup: Reversing ELF
item.description: TryHackMe beginner reverse-engineering room solving a set of ELF crackmes with execution, strings, Ghidra, Cutter, base64 decoding, XOR, and simple argument checks.

item.title: Writeup: Lockdown
item.description: TryHackMe AI security room investigating Bastion, an internal assistant with vulnerable retrieval controls, unsafe logging, and broken user-level access isolation.

item.title: Writeup: Monday Monitor
item.description: TryHackMe endpoint monitoring room using Wazuh and Sysmon logs to trace initial access, scheduled task persistence, user creation, credential dumping, and data exfiltration.

item.title: Writeup: PS Eclipse
item.description: TryHackMe Splunk investigation room tracing a suspected ransomware incident through PowerShell download activity, scheduled task privilege escalation, C2 callbacks, and BlackSun ransomware IOCs.

item.title: Writeup: Snapped Phish-ing Line
item.description: TryHackMe phishing investigation room analysing malicious emails, redirection URLs, an exposed phishing kit, captured credentials, VirusTotal results, and a decoded flag.

item.title: Writeup: TShark Challenge I - Teamwork
item.description: TryHackMe network forensics room using TShark to investigate DNS traffic, identify a suspicious phishing domain, pivot through VirusTotal, and extract an email address from a PCAP.

item.title: Writeup: TShark Challenge II - Directory
item.description: TryHackMe network forensics room using TShark to investigate directory-index browsing, identify a suspicious domain, export HTTP objects, and validate a downloaded executable in VirusTotal.

item.title: Writeup: Warzone 1
item.description: TryHackMe SOC triage room investigating an IDS alert with Brim, Wireshark, NetworkMiner, and VirusTotal to confirm malware command and control activity.

item.title: Writeup: Warzone 2
item.description: TryHackMe SOC triage room investigating IDS alerts for a network trojan, privacy-policy violations, malicious downloads, and related suspicious infrastructure.

item.title: Writeup: Checkpoint
item.description: TryHackMe AI security assessment room reviewing four deployment candidates, identifying Candidate A's supply-chain failures, and making the production deployment call.

item.title: Writeup: Compiled
item.description: TryHackMe reverse-engineering room using Ghidra to inspect a Linux binary, understand scanf input parsing, and recover the required password.

item.title: Writeup: Sakura Room
item.description: TryHackMe OSINT room using source inspection, username pivoting, GitHub history, PGP metadata, blockchain lookup, social media, WiGLE, and travel geolocation.

item.title: Writeup: Searchlight - IMINT
item.description: TryHackMe OSINT room covering imagery intelligence, geolocation, Google dorking, reverse image search, street view checks, and video frame analysis.

item.title: Writeup: AI Threat Modelling Assessment
item.description: TryHackMe assessment room testing AI threat modelling knowledge through an interactive application and two completion flags.

item.title: Writeup: Disgruntled
item.description: TryHackMe Linux forensics room investigating a disgruntled IT user's privileged commands, account creation, script staging, cron persistence, and logic bomb.

item.title: Writeup: Hide and Seek
item.description: TryHackMe Linux live-system forensics room uncovering multiple post-compromise persistence mechanisms and reconstructing a split flag from encoded artefacts.

item.title: Writeup: Infinity Shell
item.description: TryHackMe webshell forensics room investigating a PHP implant, tracing attacker query strings, and decoding a base64 payload to recover the flag.

item.title: Writeup: Invite Only
item.description: TryHackMe SOC threat-intelligence room pivoting from a flagged IP and SHA256 hash to malware family, dropped files, phishing technique, and campaign reporting.

item.title: Writeup: Juicy Details
item.description: TryHackMe SOC log-analysis room investigating attacker reconnaissance, brute forcing, SQL injection, file retrieval, and shell access against a Juice Shop environment.

item.title: Writeup: Letter
item.description: TryHackMe OSINT room using a damaged envelope, handwritten note, and newspaper clipping to identify a historic Penmarc'h rescue figure.

item.title: Writeup: Memory Forensics
item.description: TryHackMe memory forensics room using Volatility to identify profiles, dump and crack Windows hashes, recover console activity, find shutdown time, and extract a TrueCrypt passphrase.

item.title: Writeup: Missing Person
item.description: TryHackMe OSINT room using image search, event research, EXIF metadata, social media, and public business details to trace a missing person's travel trail.

item.title: Writeup: Mr. Phisher
item.description: TryHackMe phishing analysis room focused on extracting and decoding a flag hidden inside a macro-enabled Word document attachment.

item.title: Writeup: Payload
item.description: TryHackMe supply-chain incident room investigating a backdoored ML model, outbound beaconing, and a staged candidate model containing the second half of the campaign ID.

item.title: Writeup: Phishing Emails 5
item.description: TryHackMe phishing analysis room focused on investigating an email sample through headers, sender artifacts, SPF and DMARC checks, attachment hashing, and VirusTotal.

item.title: Writeup: Shadow Trace
item.description: TryHackMe malware triage room analysing a suspicious Windows updater, extracting IOCs, decoding hidden clues, and correlating EDR alert payloads.

item.title: Writeup: Sneaky Patch
item.description: TryHackMe Linux forensics room investigating a suspicious kernel module and recovering a hidden flag from a backdoored `.ko` file.

item.title: Writeup: Stolen Mount
item.description: TryHackMe packet forensics room analysing NFS traffic, extracting stolen files from a PCAP, cracking an archive password, and recovering a QR-code flag.

item.title: Writeup: Confidential
item.description: TryHackMe PDF forensics room focused on uncovering an obscured QR code and decoding it to retrieve the hidden invite flag.

item.title: Writeup: Committed
item.description: TryHackMe Git forensics room focused on recovering a sensitive flag from repository history after it was removed in a later commit.

item.title: Writeup: Disk Analysis & Autopsy
item.description: TryHackMe forensic analysis room using Autopsy to investigate a Windows disk image, recover system details, user activity, network artifacts, tools, and flags.

item.title: Writeup: Investigating Windows
item.description: TryHackMe Windows forensics room investigating a previously compromised Windows Server host through RDP, account activity, scheduled tasks, logs, network artifacts, and web shell evidence.

item.title: Writeup: Summit
item.description: TryHackMe purple-team detection engineering challenge using the Pyramid of Pain to detect malware through hashes, IPs, domains, host artifacts, tool behavior, and attacker procedures.

item.title: Writeup: Crack the Hash
item.description: TryHackMe hash cracking room covering common hashes, CrackStation lookups, and Hashcat modes for bcrypt, SHA-512 crypt, and salted SHA1.

item.title: Writeup: ToolsRus
item.description: TryHackMe room using Feroxbuster, Hydra, Nmap, Nikto, and Metasploit to enumerate and exploit an exposed Apache Tomcat Manager instance.

item.title: Writeup: Chill Hack
item.description: TryHackMe boot-to-root room covering FTP enumeration, web command injection, reverse shells, and Linux privilege escalation.

item.title: Writeup: Blue
item.description: TryHackMe beginner Windows exploitation room focused on SMB enumeration, MS17-010 EternalBlue exploitation, Meterpreter migration, hash dumping, and flag discovery.

item.title: Writeup: Footprinting Lab
item.description: Hack The Box Academy footprinting lab focused on careful service enumeration, FTP access, SSH key discovery, and retrieving the proof flag.

item.title: Writeup: Lofi
item.description: TryHackMe beginner web room demonstrating local file inclusion through a vulnerable page parameter to read the flag from the filesystem.
